outbound.choose:
<when condition="@(context.Response.StatusCode >= 200 && context.Response.StatusCode < 300)">
                @{
                    return new JObject(
                            new JProperty("EventTime", DateTimeOffset.UtcNow.ToString("yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:sszzz")),
                            new JProperty("RequestId", context.RequestId),
                            new JProperty("ProductId", context.Product.Id),
                            new JProperty("EndpointUrl", context.Request.Url.ToString()),
                            new JProperty("RequestBody", context.Request.Body.As(preserveContent: true)),
                            new JProperty("ResponseBody", context.Response.Body.As(preserveContent: true))
                        ).ToString(Newtonsoft.Json.Formatting.None);
                    }
